groups.name: usb_in
groups.why: USB-C receptacle (declared pose, south edge) with its CC1/CC2 5.1k pull-downs (R1,R2), shield RC (C1,R3), D+/D- 1nF caps (C71,C72) and the 22R D+/D- series pair (R62,R63) that borders the ESP32's USB pins

groups.name: pwr5v
groups.why: TPS62903 buck from the battery/SYS rail (VIN = Net-(U6-EN), selected by 0R R72/R73) to +5VBAT: input caps C46-C48, SS cap C49, inductor L2, FB divider R39/R40 + TP2, MODE R42, PG TP1; +5VBAT output caps C42-C45 which the decap rule ties to U7 (TPS2117 power mux, +5VUSB vs +5VBAT -> VMUX) with its PR1 divider R43/R44, ST pull-up R45 and the VMUX->+5V fuse F1; FB1 ties GND to PGND

groups.name: buck3v3
groups.why: TPS62902 buck +5V -> +3V3: input caps C2/C14/C68 (C68 is board_context's Cin), SS C4, FB divider R52/R56, MODE R57, inductor L3, +3V3 22uF output caps C3/C6

groups.name: core
groups.why: ESP32-C6-WROOM-1 (declared pose, antenna at the south edge) with its +3V3 decaps (C9,C7,C53,C73 and the F-side C10/C13), IO8 strap R4, BOOT pull-up R5 + C8 with the BOOT button SW1, EN RC R6/C67 + TP9, the TPL5010 watchdog U3 (drives EN, DONE=WD_RST) with its DELAY R7, IO22 pull-up R74, and the LED2 driver R71 + C51; the CE1 UART/I2C select solder jumpers JP2/JP3 at U1's RXD0/TXD0 pins (2 of their 3 links are U1 and the I2C bus)

groups.name: ext_io
groups.why: the I2C bus parts: the 8-pin IO1 expansion connector (IO18-20 with pull-ups R76-R78, SCL/SDA, +5V/+3V3), the 4-pin I2C3 connector, the AT24CM02 EEPROM U12 with its decap C63, and the two SCL/SDA pull-up pairs R28/R29, R32/R49 (I2C1/I2C2 headers are declared poses on the south edge)

groups.name: pm
groups.why: the two PM-sensor connectors (UART + switched 5V): TPS27081 load switch U13 (+5V -> VOUT1) with its R1/C1 pull-up R64 and EN_PM pull-down R60, VOUT1 caps C11/C32/C52 and +5V input caps C74/C5

groups.name: uart_exp
groups.why: WK2132 I2C-to-dual-UART bridge for the PM sensors: 14.7456 MHz crystal X1 with load caps C54/C55 and R46, reset RC R47/C56, IRQ pull-up R48, address straps R25/R41, the B5817 diodes D4-D7 in the PM1/PM2 TX/RX lines, decap C65

groups.name: co2
groups.why: CO2-sensor connector (UART to the ESP32) with its TPS27081 load switch U14 (+5V -> VOUT2), R1/C1 pull-up R65, EN_CO2 pull-down R58, VOUT2 caps C12/C59, +5V cap C50

groups.name: ce
groups.why: CE1 sensor connector: two TPS27081 load switches U15 (+3V3 -> VOUT3) and U16 (+5V -> VOUT4) with R1/C1 pull-ups R66/R69, shared EN_CE pull-down R61, VOUT caps C60/C62, input caps C66 (+3V3) and C57 (+5V); IO23/IO21 pull-ups R8/R75

groups.name: no2
groups.why: NO2 sensor connector (I2C): load switches U17 (+3V3 -> VOUT5) and U18 (+5V -> VOUT6) with R1/C1 pull-ups R67/R70, shared EN_NO2 pull-down R59, VOUT caps C61/C64, input caps C70 (+3V3) and C58 (+5V)

groups.name: charger
groups.why: BQ25672 solar buck-boost charger: inductor L1 (SW1-SW2) with bootstrap caps C28/C29, PMID caps C37-C40, SYS caps C26/C27 + TP7, VBAT caps C23/C30 + TP8 + BATP R36, REGN cap C36, SDRV C41, PROG R16/R33, CE R31, TS divider R34/R38/R50, ILIM R35/R37, the charge LED3 + R30, the VBAT 2-pin header Battery1 and the 5A fuse F2 from the power switch

groups.name: solar_in
groups.why: the solar input: DC jack DC1 (declared pose, east edge) and the 2-pin solar header Solarpower1 (F side), SMBJ24A TVS D3 and the Solar+ input caps C31/C33/C34/C35 ahead of the charger's VBUS/VAC pins

groups.name: batt_prot
groups.why: BQ77905 3-cell protector for the BAT1 3x18650 holder: cell-tap RC filters R9/C16, R12/C18, R14/C20, R15/C21, sense filter R10/R13/C15/C17/C19 across the 10 mOhm shunt R11, CSD18534 FETs Q1 (DSG, gate R17/R18) and Q2 (CHG, D1/D2/R19-R21 gate network), LD R24, AVDD R23/C22, config 0R R26/R27/R51, NTC1 (F side) with R22, C24/C25; the slide power switch PWR_SW1 (declared pose, east edge) on VBAT+
